label: Telegram
summary: Telegram bots implemented with grammY. The runtime pre-creates the $BOT instance from the resolved token, evaluates your code to register handlers, validates the token against the Telegram API, and then starts long polling in a dedicated Worker thread.

injected: functionsVars (same injected library pool as the JS handler)

fields.token: Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather, or an application variable reference such as $_VAR_TELEGRAM_TOKEN (resolved for the bot's environment).
fields.code: JavaScript that registers handlers on the pre-created $BOT instance. Never instantiate the bot and never call $BOT.start().
fields.params: Extra JSON merged into the sandbox AFTER the application AppVars, so params win on key collisions.

error_types.INVALID_TOKEN: Telegram answered 401 (GrammyError). The token is wrong or revoked.
error_types.CONNECTION_ERROR: Network failure reaching the Telegram API (HttpError).
error_types.STARTUP_ERROR: The script threw, timed out, or left no valid $BOT instance.
error_types.BOT_ERROR: Runtime error raised while handling an update.
